messages:
maria: quick question — can we add an 'amortized cache savings' column to the per-route cost card? current card shows raw token cost but not how much prefetch/prefix cache reduced cost.
ajay: yes we talked about this briefly in the cost sync. main challenge is attribution when multiple models and prefetch layers touch the same invocation.
sofia: +1. UX ask: the team wants a single-number savings % and a hover that breaks down how savings are computed.
ethan: implementation-wise we can use the existing cost pipeline if we emit a new field 'cache_credit' per invocation. then dashboard does group_by(route, model) sum(cost) and subtract cache_credit.
jamie: can we avoid inflating savings by double-counting shared prefetches? e.g. one prefetch serving many routes.
ajay: that's the hard bit. options: 1) allocate prefetch cost proportionally by downstream token consumption, 2) only credit route that triggered the prefetch, 3) amortize over an epoch window.
maria: product prefers proportional allocation by consumption (option 1) but wants a toggle in the UI to view sticky attribution vs proportional.
sofia: UI note: show both 'apparent savings' (proportional) and 'conservative savings' (sticky) and mark which is default. Helps sales and SRE interpret.
ethan: here's a rough SQL we can use in analytics to prototype proportional allocation:
```sql
WITH prefetchs AS (
  SELECT prefetch_id, SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens FROM prefetch_usage GROUP BY prefetch_id
), alloc AS (
  SELECT u.route, u.prefetch_id, u.tokens / p.total_tokens AS share
  FROM prefetch_usage u JOIN prefetchs p USING (prefetch_id)
)
SELECT route, SUM(share * prefetch_cost) AS allocated_prefetch_cost FROM alloc GROUP BY route;
```
ajay: nice. two operational caveats: 1) sampling — we only sample 5% of invocations in the hot path, so we need weighted aggregation, 2) latency — joining on prefetch_id may be expensive in the OLAP job unless we pre-aggregate.
jamie: for sampling add a "sample_weight" column and use weighted_sum(cost * weight). that keeps estimates stable.
sofia: telemetry change request: add a metric 'route.cache_credit_ratio' per minute so alerting can detect regressions (sudden drop in cache savings).
ethan: agree. also add a regression detection on per-model amortized cost (model_unit_cost) to catch quantization or kernel changes that increase token cost.
maria: rollout plan: 1) prototype with nightly job + a hidden UI toggle (dev-only) 2) compare proportional vs sticky for 7 days 3) default to proportional if diff < 10% across active routes, else default conservative and flag to product.
ajay: can we also show confidence intervals on the card (sampling variance)? small bars under the number.
jamie: stat comment: compute bootstrap CI using the weighted samples; shouldn't be too heavy if we do it in the offline job.
sofia: frontend: will need a tooltip text explaining sampling, attribution policy, and CI. i'll draft copy.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: nightly-cost-aggregator job succeeded (job_id=agg-2023-11-01-03) :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks — next steps: ethan/ajay to sketch analytics SQL and sampling weights, sofia/jamie to prototype UI with dev toggle, i'll coordinate an experiment. tagging @eng-sre for potential alert rules.
ethan: will push a branch with prototype query later today.
ajay: i'll add a small protobuf change to include cache_credit and sample_weight in the telemetry schema; should be backward compatible.
maria: perfect. we'll review on tomorrow's sync. :thumbsup:
